fullDescription: A high-energy, vibrant dark mode design system inspired by emergency alert systems and cyberpunk aesthetics. Featuring a striking 'seismic' color palette of deep charcoal (#0a0608), electric pinkish-red (#ff2d55), and safety orange (#ff6a00). The layout uses a structured bento-card approach with editorial typography (Clash Grotesk and Satoshi), scanline flickering effects, and grid-based backgrounds. Ideal for safety monitors, fintech apps, high-stakes SaaS dashboards, and real-time data tracking platforms.
prompt:
## Resumo
Gising! Design System: A bold, dark-themed interface characterized by electric gradients, seismic grid patterns, and staggered entrance animations. It balances high-urgency visual cues with a clean, structured layout for critical data and secure user flows.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a dark background (#0a0608) featuring a 28px square seismic grid in rgba(255,45,85,0.04). Typography: Headings in 'Clash Grotesk' (700 weight, -2px letter-spacing), body in 'Satoshi'. Primary Accents: Red (#ff2d55) and Orange (#ff6a00). Use gradients (linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00)) for buttons and branding. Buttons should have heavy glows: box-shadow(0 4px 24px rgba(255,45,85,0.55)). Input fields: #1a0d11 background, 1.5px border (#2e1520), 14px text. Animations: 2s ease-out ripple rings around icons, and a 6s linear vertical scanline flicker.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Page Wrapper & Background
The page is a full-height container with overflow-hidden. Background is #0a0608 with three radial gradients: 300px ellipse at top-center (rgba(255,45,85,0.22)), 180px at 95% 55% (orange), and 140px at 0% 80% (red). Overlaid with a 28px grid and a moving 2px horizontal scanline.

### Header & Branding
Top-centered logo section. Central icon in a 68px gradient shell with three expanding 9999px border rings (ripple animation). App name below in 46px Clash Grotesk, followed by a 11px uppercase subtitle with 0.12em tracking. Include a 'Live' pill component with a blinking 8px dot and 10.5px bold text.

### Auth Card
Central card with background #130b0e, 1px border #2e1520, and 16px padding. 24px title and 13.5px muted description. Form fields are stacked with 16px gap. Each field has an 11px uppercase label (#ff9ab0). CTAs are full-width with a vibrant gradient and 20px icons.

### Bottom Navigation
Fixed bar at the bottom, height approx 80px. Background #0e080b, top border 1px #2e1520. Contains 4 even-spaced tabs. Each tab: 22px icon top, 10px uppercase label bottom. Interactive states use #ff2d55, while inactive states use #6b3345.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Seismic Ripple Logo — An animated brand icon with expanding concentric circles.
A 68px rounded-square (22px radius) button with a gradient from #ff2d55 to #ff6a00. Behind it, place three absolute-positioned 1.5px borders with 9999px radius. Animate these rings with @keyframes ripple: scale from 1 to 2.2 and opacity from 0.55 to 0 over 2 seconds, staggered by 0.65s intervals.

### Live Status Pill — A small indicator for real-time activity.
A pill-shaped container (rounded-full) with background rgba(255,45,85,0.12) and 1px border. Inside, an 8px dot #ff2d55 with a pulse glow and text 'MONITORING ACTIVE' in 10.5px bold, uppercase, 0.1em letter-spacing.

### Gradient CTA Button — A high-impact primary action button.
A 16px-radius button with a linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00). Include a subtle inset top border (0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15)). Shadow should be double-layered: one sharp glow (0 4px 24px rgba(255,45,85,0.55)) and one soft spread (0 8px 40px rgba(255,106,0,0.25)). Scale to 0.97 on active state.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the high-contrast ratio between text and dark backgrounds. MUST use the staggered 'fade-up' animation (20px translate) for all sections on page load to create a high-end feel. DO NOT use generic rounded corners; specifically use 22px for logo shells and 12px-16px for cards/buttons. DO NOT use bright white for secondary text; use #ff9ab0 or #6b3345 to maintain the color theme.
